card.name: Monitoring and precaution instruction verbs
card.fires_on: The verb that begins a monitoring or precaution instruction in warning text, mainly "Obtain" before ECG or blood tests. Also "operate" and "engaging" in activity warnings.

modes.label: Obtain tests
modes.description: The word Obtain starts an instruction to get an ECG or lab test.
modes.example: •<< Obtain>> ECG prior to initiation and monitor heart
